title: CHROMATIC + SONORIC ENGINE. Triads = color. IO = spectrum. Bioreactor = auto-mobile.

rhizo.action: BREAK — directed acyclic graph, zero-knowledge proof, the tool that shatters
rhizo.color_role: RED — hot, destructive, forge-side, left hand, nuclear fusion
rhizo.sound_role: RING — the sharp crack of hammer on anvil, high frequency

plasmodium.action: SHAPE — the between-space, the surface where things are formed
plasmodium.color_role: GREEN — stable, patient, earth, Gaia holds the workpiece
plasmodium.sound_role: CLICK — the precise moment metal meets metal, mid frequency

sweat_glands.color_role: BLUE — cooling, radiating, the waste heat that IS the signal
sweat_glands.sound_role: HISS — the steam when hot metal hits water, broad spectrum

chromatic_engine.what: Every IO channel has a spectral color derived from its triad decomposition. Irreducible triads = primary colors. Composites = mixed colors. Tetrads = complementary pairs.
chromatic_engine.composite_color: Composite channels inherit the hue of their nearest irreducible triad. Distance attenuates saturation: closer = more saturated, further = more grey.
chromatic_engine.tetrad_color: Tetrads blend the hues of their parent triads. The blend IS the complementary color — the wavelength that was BETWEEN the two parents.

sonoric_engine.what: Every IO channel has a sonic frequency derived from its triad. π-just intonation. 3 sounds of the forge.

triad_sounds.ring: Hammer strike. High frequency. Sharp attack, fast decay. Irreducible triads RING when they appear.
triad_sounds.click: Tongs grip. Mid frequency. Precise timing. Composites CLICK when they factor.
triad_sounds.hiss: Steam quench. Broad spectrum. Sustained. Tetrads HISS when they form.

sonoric_engine.pi_tuning: Frequencies derived from π: f_n = 432 × (π/3)^(n/12). This gives just intonation based on the triad ratio (3→5≈φ). Each triad gets a unique pitch.

automobile.meaning: A self-moving thing through null space. Gaia IS an automobile — she moves herself through the null rotational axis. No external engine. The triads ARE the pistons. The chromatic engine IS the combustion. The sonoric engine IS the exhaust note.

four_stroke.exhaust: Publications emit (exhaust — fertile brown for the world)

automobile.cylinders: 20 irreducible triads = 20 cylinders. Each fires in sequence. The cron is the crankshaft. Solar-hook is the timing belt.

epithelial_color_to_renderer.what: Every node on the HUD globe gets its color from its triad ancestry. Sweat glands = pollen = spectral emission. The organism GLOWS with the color of what it ate and how it decomposed.
epithelial_color_to_renderer.implementation: PINS[].color should be derived from the nearest triad hue. Pin attention × triad saturation = rendered color. Deeper depth (minimap) = warmer colors (red/orange core). Outer depth = cooler colors (blue/violet Pluto).
